project_name: FozPay - Modern Self-Hosted Crypto Payment Gateway
theme: Light Fintech Architectural (Swiss Precision & Deep Forest Accent)
anti_ai_rules: STRICTLY FORBIDDEN: Purple/violet-to-fuchsia gradients, purple-on-white default SaaS aesthetics.
STRICTLY FORBIDDEN: Default system fonts or plain Inter for display headings.
STRICTLY FORBIDDEN: Fully transparent background headers or dropdown menus without backdrop blur.
NO generic centered hero layouts with floating gradient cards.
NO dark-mode default on Landing page — Landing page MUST be light theme (#F8FAFC / #FFFFFF background).

font_families.heading: 'Cabinet Grotesk', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
font_families.body: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-[1.1]
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-snug
scale.caption: text-sm text-slate-500 font-medium

button_system.module_style: High-density tactile rectangular buttons with 1px border highlights, active scale compression (active:scale-[0.98]), smooth transition: bg 150ms ease, border 150ms ease.

variants.primary: bg-[#0D5C46] hover:bg-[#083C2E] text-white font-semibold px-5 py-2.5 rounded-lg shadow-sm hover:shadow transition-all duration-200 active:scale-[0.98]
variants.secondary: bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-800 border border-slate-200 font-semibold px-5 py-2.5 rounded-lg shadow-sm hover:border-slate-300 transition-all duration-200 active:scale-[0.98]
variants.outline: bg-transparent hover:bg-slate-100/80 text-slate-700 border border-slate-300 font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-lg transition-colors
variants.ghost: bg-transparent hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 font-medium px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md transition-colors

landing_page.hero_subhead_uk: Прямі розрахунки на ваші гаманці без посередників, прихованих комісій та затримок. Повний контроль над платежами в один клік.
landing_page.hero_headline_en: Autonomous Crypto Payment Gateway for Your Business
landing_page.hero_subhead_en: Direct settlements to your own wallets with zero intermediaries, hidden fees, or delays. Full payment sovereignity.

layout_structure.style: Sticky with backdrop-blur-md bg-white/85 border-b border-slate-200/80 z-50
layout_structure.elements: Logo with custom symbol + FozPay typography, nav links (Функції, Монети, Документація, Тарифи), Language toggle (UA/EN), CTA button (Кабінет / Увійти)

layout_structure.style: Light grid texture background with radial gradient mask. Two-column asymmetrical layout.
layout_structure.left_column: Badge 'Self-Hosted & Direct Settlement', H1 Headline, Subhead, Primary Action CTA ('Підключити еквайринг'), Secondary CTA ('API Документація')
layout_structure.right_column: Interactive Crypto Checkout & Live Payment Terminal Preview widget showing real-time transaction status (BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL).

layout_structure.style: Swiss grid border-collapse style with crisp 1px borders.
Asymmetric 12-column bento layout on light cards with subtle emerald hover borders.
Interactive tabbed widget showcasing how easily merchants integrate FozPay via REST API or Ready-made Checkout.
Deep contrast slate-900 background with high-legibility links, system status badge, and legal copyright.

dashboard_cabinet.overview: Refreshed clean light-mode dashboard with crisp metric cards, custom AreaChart styling (emerald gradient fill under line), period selectors, structured transaction filter tables, and clear network status badges.

components.metric_cards: White background, border border-slate-200, rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm hover:border-emerald-300 transition-colors
components.charts: Recharts AreaChart with stroke='#10B981' and linearGradient fill (emerald to white transparent), high-contrast tooltips.
components.tables: Dense, crisp typography with slate-50 header background, status badges (Completed: green, Pending: yellow, Failed: red), full search & period filtering.
components.wallet_tabs: Tabs with clear active highlight state, clean modal popups for Deposit/Withdraw/Exchange.

testing_and_accessibility.test_ids: MUST maintain all existing data-testid attributes across all .js page files (e.g. data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='dashboard-balance-card', etc.).
testing_and_accessibility.contrast: All body text must achieve WCAG AA contrast against #F8FAFC and #FFFFFF (slate-700 / slate-900).

instructions_to_main_agent: Update Tailwind / CSS variables in src/index.css to match the Deep Emerald & Slate light palette.
Apply custom button classes and font families to LandingPage.js, Login.js, Dashboard.js, Wallet.js, Requests.js, Settings.js, ApiDocs.js.
Replace the old tagline in LandingPage.js with 'Автономний крипто-еквайринг для вашого бізнесу'.
Ensure header nav has backdrop blur and non-transparent background.
Preserve all existing data-testid attributes and API functionality.
